content.study:
Section 85 — Repeal and savings

Section 85 repeals the Arbitration (Protocol and Convention) Act, 1937, the Arbitration Act, 1940 and the Foreign Awards (Recognition and Enforcement) Act, 1961, while preserving the specified transitional application of the repealed enactments and their rules and notifications.

The section is a savings/repeal provision. Its transitional effect must be applied according to the statutory commencement dates and express saving language.
